description_en: Modifies the logon configuration of a bound identity provider in a specified workspace. DingTalk and Lark support logon switches, incremental synchronization switches, application configurations, and synchronization scopes. CustomSSO supports SAML configurations and logon switches. Actual updates take effect asynchronously. Call GetIdentityProvider to query the status
description_zh: 修改指定工作空间已绑定身份源的登录配置。DingTalk、Feishu 支持登录开关、增量同步开关、应用配置和同步范围；CustomSSO 支持 SAML 配置和登录开关。实际更新异步生效，请通过 GetIdentityProvider 查询状态
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore update-identity-provider --workspace-id ws-123456 --identity-provider-type DingTalk --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateIdentityProvider

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the identity provider belongs. The request region must be the same as the region of the target workspace
parameters.help_zh: 身份源所属的工作空间 ID。请求地域应与目标工作空间一致
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the identity provider. DingTalk: DingTalk. Feishu: Lark. CustomSSO: custom enterprise identity provider connected through SAML. The value must be the same as the type of the identity provider bound to the current workspace
parameters.help_zh: 身份源类型。DingTalk：钉钉；Feishu：飞书；CustomSSO：通过 SAML 接入的自定义企业身份源。应与当前工作空间已绑定的身份源类型一致
parameters.name: identity_provider_type

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow logon by using this identity provider. If this parameter is omitted or set to null during an update, the original value is retained. For CustomSSO, a valid SAML configuration must exist before logon is enabled. Disabling logon does not delete the saved SAML or SCIM configurations
fields.help_zh: 是否允许使用该身份源登录。更新时省略或为 null 保留原值。CustomSSO 开启登录前须已有有效 SAML 配置；关闭登录不删除已保存的 SAML 或 SCIM 配置
fields.name: login_enabled

fields.help_en: The App ID of the Lark application. If this parameter is omitted during an update, the existing value is retained. If explicitly submitted, it must be a non-empty value. The merged configuration for Lark must include this field
fields.help_zh: 飞书应用的 App ID。更新时省略保留已有值；显式提交时须为非空值。飞书合并后的配置必须包含该字段
fields.name: app_id

fields.help_en: The AppKey of the DingTalk application. If this parameter is omitted during an update, the existing value is retained. If explicitly submitted, it must be a non-empty value. The merged configuration for DingTalk must include this field
fields.help_zh: 钉钉应用的 AppKey。更新时省略保留已有值；显式提交时须为非空值。钉钉合并后的配置必须包含该字段
fields.name: app_key

fields.help_en: The AppSecret of the DingTalk or Lark application. If this parameter is omitted during an update, the existing secret is retained and does not need to be retransmitted each time. If explicitly submitted, it must be a non-empty value, and the merged configuration must include this field. This is sensitive input and is not echoed in queries. The example is a fictitious value
fields.help_zh: 钉钉或飞书应用的 AppSecret。更新时省略保留已有密钥，无需每次重传；显式提交时须为非空值，合并后的配置必须包含该字段。属于敏感输入，查询不回显。示例为虚构值
fields.name: app_secret

fields.help_en: The CorpId of the organization to which the DingTalk application belongs. If this parameter is omitted during an update, the existing value is retained. If explicitly submitted, it must be a non-empty value and must match the organization to which the application belongs. The merged configuration for DingTalk must include this field
fields.help_zh: 钉钉应用所属组织的 CorpId。更新时省略保留已有值；显式提交时须为非空值，且须与应用所属组织一致。钉钉合并后的配置必须包含该字段
fields.name: corp_id

fields.help_en: The encryption key for vendor event callbacks, which must be consistent with the vendor application configuration. If this parameter is omitted during an update, the existing value is retained. When incremental synchronization is enabled, the merged configuration must include this field. This is sensitive input and is not echoed in queries
fields.help_zh: 厂商事件回调的加密密钥，应与厂商应用配置一致。更新时省略保留已有值；启用增量同步时，合并后的配置必须包含该字段。属于敏感输入，查询不回显
fields.name: encrypt_key

fields.help_en: The verification token for vendor event callbacks, which must be consistent with the vendor application configuration. If this parameter is omitted during an update, the existing value is retained. When incremental synchronization is enabled, the merged configuration must include this field. This is sensitive input and is not echoed in queries
fields.help_zh: 厂商事件回调的校验令牌，应与厂商应用配置一致。更新时省略保留已有值；启用增量同步时，合并后的配置必须包含该字段。属于敏感输入，查询不回显
fields.name: verification_token

fields.help_en: Applies only to DingTalk and Lark. The application configuration is merged by field. Omitted fields and existing keys retain their original values. Explicitly submitted fields must not be null, empty strings, or blank strings. The merged configuration must meet the complete configuration requirements of the vendor. CustomSSO does not accept this field
fields.help_zh: 仅适用于 DingTalk、Feishu，按字段合并应用配置。省略字段及已有密钥保留原值；显式提交的字段不得为 null、空串或空白串，合并后须满足该厂商的完整配置要求。CustomSSO 不接受此字段
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en: The logon protocol, which applies only to CustomSSO. Currently, only SAML is supported. DingTalk and Lark do not accept this field. If submitted with a non-empty saml configuration, this field can be omitted and the server processes it as SAML
fields.help_zh: 仅适用于 CustomSSO 的登录协议，当前仅支持 SAML。DingTalk、Feishu 不接受此字段。与非空 saml 配置一同提交时，可省略，由服务端按 SAML 处理
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The binding type for manual SAML configuration. HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST are supported. This parameter must be submitted together with entityId, loginUrl, and x509Certificates, and cannot be mixed with metadataXml
fields.help_zh: 手填 SAML 配置时的绑定类型，支持 HTTP-Redirect 和 HTTP-POST；须与 entityId、loginUrl、x509Certificates 一同提交，不能与 metadataXml 混用
fields.name: binding_type

fields.help_en: The entity ID of the enterprise IdP. This parameter is required for manual configuration. It must be non-empty and up to 2,048 characters, and cannot be changed after saving. It must be submitted together with loginUrl, bindingType, and x509Certificates, and cannot be mixed with metadataXml
fields.help_zh: 企业 IdP 的实体标识。手填时必填，须非空且不超过 2048 字符；保存后不支持更换。须与 loginUrl、bindingType、x509Certificates 一同提交，不能与 metadataXml 混用
fields.name: entity_id

fields.help_en: The SSO logon URL of the enterprise IdP. This parameter is required for manual configuration. It must be an absolute HTTPS URL without user credentials and fragments. It must be submitted together with entityId, bindingType, and x509Certificates, and cannot be mixed with metadataXml
fields.help_zh: 企业 IdP 的 SSO 登录地址。手填时必填，须为不含用户凭据和片段的绝对 HTTPS URL；须与 entityId、bindingType、x509Certificates 一同提交，不能与 metadataXml 混用
fields.name: login_url

fields.help_en: The original SAML metadata XML text of the enterprise IdP, not a URL or file path. The maximum size is 1 MiB. It must contain a single EntityDescriptor. DTDs and external entities are prohibited. It cannot be mixed with the four manual configuration fields. After saving, queries return the standardized configuration and do not echo the original XML text
fields.help_zh: 企业 IdP 的 SAML Metadata XML 原文，不是 URL 或文件路径。最多 1 MiB，须包含单个 EntityDescriptor，禁止 DTD 和外部实体。不能与四项手填配置混用。保存后查询返回标准化配置，不回显 XML 原文
fields.name: metadata_xml

fields.help_en: The list of X.509 signing certificates for the enterprise IdP. For manual configuration, a non-empty list must be provided, with a maximum of 10 certificates. The certificates must be valid. This parameter must be submitted together with entityId, loginUrl, and bindingType, and cannot be mixed with metadataXml
fields.help_zh: 企业 IdP 的 X.509 签名证书列表。手填时须提供非空列表，最多十张，证书须在有效期内；须与 entityId、loginUrl、bindingType 一同提交，不能与 metadataXml 混用
fields.name: x509_certificates

fields.help_en: Applies only to CustomSSO. You can either provide metadataXml or provide the four complete manual configuration fields. The two methods cannot be mixed. If a valid configuration already exists, you can also modify only the JIT switches. Saving the configuration does not automatically enable logon
fields.help_zh: 仅适用于 CustomSSO。提供 metadataXml 与提供四项完整手填配置二选一；两种方式不得混用。已有有效配置时，也可仅修改 JIT 开关。保存配置不会自动开启登录
fields.name: saml

fields.help_en: Applies only to DingTalk and Lark. Controls the incremental synchronization of subsequent address book change events. If this parameter is omitted or set to null during an update, the original value is retained. It does not control the initial synchronization or manual synchronization. When enabled, the merged metadata must include encryptKey and verificationToken. For CustomSSO, use UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM to manage the synchronization switch
fields.help_zh: 仅适用于 DingTalk、Feishu，控制后续通讯录变更事件的增量同步。更新时省略或为 null 保留原值；不控制首次同步或手动同步。启用时合并后的 metadata 须含 encryptKey 和 verificationToken。CustomSSO 请改用 UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM 管理同步开关
fields.name: sync_enabled

fields.help_en: The list of department IDs in the synchronization scope, obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments. In SelectedDepartments mode, at least one non-empty department ID must be provided. In AllAuthorized mode, this parameter should be omitted or an empty array should be passed
fields.help_zh: 同步范围中的部门 ID 列表，取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments。SelectedDepartments 模式至少提供一个非空部门 ID；AllAuthorized 模式应省略或传空数组
fields.name: department_ids

fields.help_en: The synchronization scope mode. AllAuthorized: all members within the authorization scope of the application address book. SelectedDepartments: the selected departments and all their sub-departments. A valid mode must be provided when syncScope is explicitly submitted
fields.help_zh: 同步范围模式。AllAuthorized：应用通讯录授权范围内的全部成员；SelectedDepartments：选中部门及其所有子部门。显式提交 syncScope 时必须提供有效模式
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The address book synchronization scope, which applies only to DingTalk and Lark. If this parameter is omitted or set to null, the current scope is retained. Saving the scope does not automatically trigger a full synchronization. CustomSSO does not accept this field
fields.help_zh: 仅适用于 DingTalk、Feishu 的通讯录同步范围。省略或为 null 保留当前范围；保存范围不会自动执行全量同步。CustomSSO 不接受此字段
fields.name: sync_scope

parameters.help_en: The configuration fields to be modified. For DingTalk and Lark, you must submit at least one of loginEnabled, syncEnabled, metadata, and syncScope. For CustomSSO, use protocol, saml, and loginEnabled. You cannot submit vendor metadata, syncEnabled, or syncScope
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的配置字段。钉钉、飞书至少提交 loginEnabled、syncEnabled、metadata、syncScope 中的一项；CustomSSO 使用 protocol、saml、loginEnabled，不能提交厂商 metadata、syncEnabled 或 syncScope
parameters.name: body

code.description_en: The business status code of the API request. SUCCESS indicates that the request is successful, but does not mean that the asynchronous configuration or synchronization task is completed
code.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的业务状态码。SUCCESS 表示请求成功，不代表异步配置或同步任务已经完成

data.description_en: The currently saved identity provider binding information, including the expected configuration and resource status. The actual update may still be executing in the background
data.description_zh: 当前保存的身份源绑定信息，包含期望配置和资源状态；实际更新可能仍在后台执行

configuration.description_en: The actual SAML configuration read back from the upstream. This update operation does not perform the read-back and usually does not return this field. Use GetIdentityProvider to obtain it
configuration.description_zh: 从上游回读的 SAML 实际配置。本更新接口不执行该回读，通常不返回此字段；请通过 GetIdentityProvider 获取

bindingType.description_en: The actual SAML binding type saved in the upstream, which is HTTP-Redirect or HTTP-POST
bindingType.description_zh: 上游实际保存的 SAML 绑定类型，HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST

entityId.description_en: The actual enterprise IdP entity ID saved in the upstream
entityId.description_zh: 上游实际保存的企业 IdP 实体标识

loginUrl.description_en: The actual enterprise IdP SSO logon URL saved in the upstream
loginUrl.description_zh: 上游实际保存的企业 IdP SSO 登录地址

ssoStatus.description_en: The actual SSO logon status in the upstream. Enabled indicates that it is turned on, and Disabled indicates that it is turned off. This should be evaluated separately from the expected value of loginEnabled
ssoStatus.description_zh: 上游实际的 SSO 登录状态。Enabled 表示开启，Disabled 表示关闭；应与 loginEnabled 期望值分别判断
ssoStatus.title_en: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态
ssoStatus.title_zh: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态

identityProviderType.description_en: The type of the identity provider. DingTalk: DingTalk. Feishu: Lark. CustomSSO: custom enterprise identity provider connected through SAML. The value must be the same as the type of the identity provider bound to the current workspace
identityProviderType.description_zh: 身份源类型。DingTalk：钉钉；Feishu：飞书；CustomSSO：通过 SAML 接入的自定义企业身份源。应与当前工作空间已绑定的身份源类型一致

loginEnabled.description_en: The currently saved expected value of the logon switch, which alone does not prove that the upstream logon configuration has taken effect
loginEnabled.description_zh: 当前保存的登录开关期望值，不单独证明上游登录配置已经生效

protocol.description_en: The currently saved logon protocol for CustomSSO, which is SAML when configured. This field is not returned for DingTalk or Lark
protocol.description_zh: CustomSSO 当前保存的登录协议；已配置时为 SAML。钉钉、飞书不返回此字段

saml.description_en: The saved standardized SAML configuration for CustomSSO. The original metadata XML is not echoed. This field is not returned if no valid configuration is saved or if the identity provider is DingTalk or Lark. This value is the locally saved configuration and is not equivalent to the actual upstream configuration
saml.description_zh: CustomSSO 已保存的标准化 SAML 配置，不回显原始 Metadata XML。尚未保存有效配置或身份源为钉钉、飞书时不返回。该值是本地保存配置，不等同于上游实际配置

bindingType.description_en: The saved SAML binding type, which is HTTP-Redirect or HTTP-POST
bindingType.description_zh: 已保存的 SAML 绑定类型，HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST

entityId.description_en: The saved enterprise IdP entity ID, which is different from the entity ID of the service provider (SP)
entityId.description_zh: 已保存的企业 IdP 实体标识，与服务提供方 SP 的 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: The saved enterprise IdP SSO logon URL
loginUrl.description_zh: 已保存的企业 IdP SSO 登录地址

x509Certificates.description_en: The list of saved enterprise IdP X.509 signing certificates
x509Certificates.description_zh: 已保存的企业 IdP X.509 签名证书列表

items.description_en: A saved enterprise IdP X.509 signing certificate, returned in PEM format
items.description_zh: 一张已保存的企业 IdP X.509 签名证书，使用 PEM 格式返回

status.description_en:
The status of the identity provider resource and logon configuration. Valid values:
CONFIGURED: The configuration is accepted.
UPDATING: The configuration is being updated.
SYNCING: Synchronization is in progress.
SYNCED: The synchronization phase is completed.
READY: The resource is ready.
SYNC_FAILED: Synchronization failed.
UPDATE_FAILED: The update failed.
DISCONNECTING: Unbinding is in progress.
DISCONNECT_FAILED: Unbinding failed.
READY alone does not indicate that users have been imported. Query the SCIM operation results for CustomSSO separately
status.description_zh: 身份源资源及登录配置状态。CONFIGURED：配置已受理；UPDATING：更新中；SYNCING：同步中；SYNCED：同步阶段完成；READY：资源就绪；SYNC_FAILED：同步失败；UPDATE_FAILED：更新失败；DISCONNECTING：解绑中；DISCONNECT_FAILED：解绑失败。READY 不单独表示已导入用户，CustomSSO 的 SCIM 操作结果应另行查询
status.title_en: 身份源资源及登录配置状态
status.title_zh: 身份源资源及登录配置状态

syncEnabled.description_en: The currently saved expected value of the synchronization switch. For DingTalk and Lark, it is used for subsequent address book change events. The SCIM switch for CustomSSO is managed through UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM, and the operation results are queried through GetIdentityProviderSCIM
syncEnabled.description_zh: 当前保存的同步开关期望值。钉钉、飞书用于后续通讯录变更事件；CustomSSO 的 SCIM 开关通过 UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM 管理，操作结果通过 GetIdentityProviderSCIM 查询

syncScope.description_en: The saved synchronization scope for DingTalk and Lark. The default value for valid historical configurations is AllAuthorized, and this field may not be returned for corrupted historical configurations. This field is not returned for CustomSSO
syncScope.description_zh: 钉钉、飞书已保存的同步范围。历史有效配置缺省为 AllAuthorized，损坏的历史配置可能不返回。CustomSSO 不返回此字段

departmentIds.description_en: The list of department IDs in the synchronization scope, obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments. In SelectedDepartments mode, at least one non-empty department ID must be provided. In AllAuthorized mode, this parameter should be omitted or an empty array should be passed
departmentIds.description_zh: 同步范围中的部门 ID 列表，取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments。SelectedDepartments 模式至少提供一个非空部门 ID；AllAuthorized 模式应省略或传空数组

items.description_en: The unique identifier of the department returned by the identity provider, obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments
items.description_zh: 身份源返回的部门唯一标识，取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments

mode.description_en: The synchronization scope mode. AllAuthorized: all members within the authorization scope of the application address book. SelectedDepartments: the selected departments and all their sub-departments. A valid mode must be provided when syncScope is explicitly submitted
mode.description_zh: 同步范围模式。AllAuthorized：应用通讯录授权范围内的全部成员；SelectedDepartments：选中部门及其所有子部门。显式提交 syncScope 时必须提供有效模式

syncScope.title_en: 已配置的同步范围；历史有效配置缺省为 AllAuthorized，损坏的历史配置可能不返回此字段
syncScope.title_zh: 已配置的同步范围；历史有效配置缺省为 AllAuthorized，损坏的历史配置可能不返回此字段

workspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the identity provider belongs
workspaceId.description_zh: 身份源所属的工作空间 ID

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the API request, which does not represent the execution result of the background task
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的 HTTP 状态码，不代表后台任务的执行结果

message.description_en: The response message of the API request. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的响应消息；请求失败时返回错误说明

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. Provide this value when you troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识。排查问题时请提供该值

success.description_en: Indicates whether the API request is successful. To check whether the background configuration has taken effect, query the identity provider status separately
success.description_zh: 本次 API 请求是否成功。后台配置是否生效须另行查询身份源状态
